blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) more than doubled its profits in the first eight months, despite a mild decline in revenues, thanks to lower expenses and foreign exchange gains. The BSP reported a net income of P175.8 billion in the January-August period, up from P86.9 billion in the same period last year, according to data posted on the central bank’s website. READ: Forex gains boosted BSP 4-month profit to P100B Broken down, total revenues dipped 2.3 percent from a year earlier to P182.7 billion.
